name: Puffling And The Stormy Sea by Gerry Daly & Erika McGann

pages.title: Puffling And The Stormy Sea By Erika Mcgann | Easons Books
pages.description: A brave puffling is swept into adventure on Skellig Michael in this warm, windswept animal story for young readers — FREE DELIVERY OVER €10
pages.ld_description:
A brave little puffling lives on Skellig Michael.
It's a windy, stormy day - a perfect day for a wild adventure. But she ends up far from home!
Can her new animal friends help her find her way back?
Ideal for readers who:

Love picture-book adventures with animals, jeopardy and a reassuring ending.
Are charmed by stories where a small creature gets lost and must find her way home.
Would enjoy Skellig Michael, seabirds and a windswept island world brought to life.
Prefer gentle, atmospheric reads that mix excitement with comfort.
